turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you too, Dr. Smith. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me today, I really appreciate it. 

Well, um, what brings me in is... I guess it's a little embarrassing to admit, but I've been having these moments where... well, like at the museum where I spend my time. People will be talking right to me, you know, telling me all about the plans for the next art walk, and I’ll be looking right at them, nodding along. But then I suddenly realize I completely missed the middle of what they just said. I end up having to apologize and ask them to run it by me again. 

I mean, it's probably not a huge deal, right? Everyone gets a little scatterbrained sometimes, especially at my age. But I didn't want to come across as rude to folks, so I just wanted to make sure I'm doing the right thing by getting it checked out. Does that... does that make sense for why I'm here?
